questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All lakes are ponds.

All ponds are rivers.

Conclusions:

(I): All lakes are rivers.

(II): All rivers are ponds

options.text: Neither Conclusion I nor II follows
Both Conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
__Least possible Venn diagram__:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a0c258f1e2173e73a887170440cc80a3974e540fc4a0ac7c719a7228b2df00fb.png] 

Conclusions:

(I): All lakes are rivers. - True (All lakes are ponds, and all ponds are rivers. All lakes are River is True.)

(II): All rivers are ponds—False ( All ponds are rivers but All river are pond is may be possible but not definte. Hence, it is false.)

Only Conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**

questions.question: In a row of 111 persons facing north, Mukesh is 19th from the left end. What is his position from the right end?
questions.solution:
Total number of people: 111

Mukesh's position from the left: 19

 Position from Right = Total Persons - Position from Left + 1

111 – 19 + 1 = 92 + 1

=93.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**

Statements:

All levers are drums.

Conclusions:

(I) Some drums are levers.

(II) All games are drums.
questions.solution:
The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb25d1a9968cd3b741592325e47714e18de5ffafc1edb07d6b8f2d002f94fad3.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some drums are levers. - True ( All levers are Drums means some drums are levers and some levers are drums is True.)

(II) All games are drums. - True ( All Games are levers and All Levers are Drums means All games are drums is True.)

Both conclusions (I) and (II) follow.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
